reference_images.description: long rectangular stone classroom carved into a mountain, rough grey-teal stone walls with damp marks along the base, a low worn wooden lecture desk at the front, two facing rows of ten straw cushions each with a coarse clay bowl of clear water in front, a heavy wooden door on the left wall leaking a thin line of morning light, grey daylight falling from a crack in the stone ceiling, worn grey flagstone floor, cold grey-teal tones, early morning

about 40-year-old slender upright East Asian woman, oval face with a clean jawline, slightly downturned outer eye corners, very dark eyes with faint red veins and tired shadows beneath, pale greyish skin, black hair streaked with early grey strands pulled into a tight bun with a single plain wooden hairpin, pale unpainted lips, wearing deep ink-teal cross-collar long robe with tightly bound cuffs, dark plain sash, small square white jade instructor token on a teal cord at the left hip

external_narration.speaker: C-func-disciple-a
external_narration.line: 我忘掉母親教我說的第一句話。
